convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh, AccountInfo.mqh) for trading logic and position management. Also implements a custom ParabolicSAR trailing stop algorithm inline rather than using the built-in iSAR indicator, requiring careful manual translation of the stateful trailing logic.

derived_values.name: m_adjusted_point - point adjusted for 3/5 digit brokers
derived_values.used_by: SL, TP, trailing stop, MACD open/close levels

derived_values.name: m_trailing_stop - trailing stop distance in price units
ParabolicSAR trailing stop (inline calculation)
derived_values.formula: long: sl + (highest_high - sl) * min(InpPSAR_Maximum, m_trailing_step + InpPSAR_Step); short: sl - (sl - lowest_low) * min(InpPSAR_Maximum, m_trailing_step + InpPSAR_Step)

derived_values.name: m_trailing_step - PSAR acceleration factor
derived_values.formula: fmin(InpPSAR_Maximum, m_trailing_step + InpPSAR_Step) on new extreme

derived_values.name: m_trailing_max - PSAR extreme price
derived_values.formula: long: max of previous extreme and last bar high; short: min of previous extreme and last bar low

params.modes: None, Fixed (30 pips), FixedPSAR (inline PSAR calculation)

other_exits: Long close: MACD main > 0 AND MACD main crosses below signal AND MACD main > m_macd_close_level
Short close: MACD main < 0 AND MACD main crosses above signal AND MathAbs(MACD main) > m_macd_close_level
Fixed trailing stop: moves SL to Bid-trailing_stop (long) or Ask+trailing_stop (short) when position is in profit by InpTrailingStop pips
FixedPSAR trailing: inline ParabolicSAR calculation tracking extremes and accelerating step factor, only modifies SL when new extreme is reached and SAR stop is on correct side of price

custom_logic_notes: The FixedPSAR trailing stop is a manual inline implementation of ParabolicSAR, NOT using the built-in iSAR indicator. It maintains stateful m_trailing_max and m_trailing_step variables that reset on position open and update only when a new price extreme is reached. The step accelerates by InpPSAR_Step each time a new extreme is hit, capped at InpPSAR_Maximum. There is a 10-second timeout (ExtTimeOut) between trade operations via limit_time mechanism. The lot validation code in InitCheckParameters is commented out. MACD indicator uses hardcoded periods (12,26,9) not from inputs. Entry uses previous bar values ([1]) for crossover detection while current bar ([0]) for level/threshold checks. The position_gate is no_position because m_position.Select(Symbol()) must fail (no existing position) before entry logic runs.
python_conversion_notes: Key challenges: (1) The inline PSAR trailing logic is stateful - m_trailing_max and m_trailing_step reset on position open and evolve with each bar, must be maintained as position-level state in Python. (2) The 10-second timeout between trades uses TimeCurrent() which approximates to last tick time - in Python backtesting this needs bar timestamp tracking. (3) Digit adjustment logic (5-digit vs 4-digit) must be handled - SL/TP/levels are multiplied by 10 for 5-digit brokers. (4) The CTrade/CSymbolInfo/CPositionInfo/CAccountInfo wrapper classes provide RefreshRates(), PositionSelect, FreeMarginCheck etc. that must be replicated with broker API calls or backtesting framework equivalents. (5) ArraySetAsSeries(true) means index [0] = most recent bar, [1] = previous bar - ensure consistent indexing in Python. (6) NormalizeDouble must be replicated to proper decimal rounding. (7) The MACD open/close level filters compare absolute MACD values against price-distance thresholds converted to indicator units - verify unit consistency in Python.
